description: Defines internal low-level scheduling mechanisms and the SchedulingGuard class used to disable and enable cooperative rescheduling within specific code regions, primarily for synchronization purposes in the Abseil library.

classes.name: SchedulingGuard
classes.description: Provides guard semantics to disable and enable cooperative rescheduling of the calling thread, used for protecting low-level resources and ensuring thread safety in the Abseil library.

classes.name: SchedulingGuard::ScopedDisable
classes.description: Scoped helper that disables rescheduling upon construction and re-enables it upon destruction.

classes.name: SchedulingGuard::ScopedEnable
classes.description: Scoped helper that temporarily enables rescheduling within its lifetime.

methods.name: ReschedulingIsAllowed
methods.description: Returns whether the calling thread may be cooperatively rescheduled.

methods.name: DisableRescheduling
methods.description: Disables cooperative rescheduling for the calling thread.

methods.name: EnableRescheduling
methods.description: Re-enables cooperative rescheduling for the calling thread, matching a previous disable.

methods.name: ScopedEnable::~ScopedEnable
methods.description: Destructor that checks for proper nesting of rescheduling enablement.
